Sedjem 0.3.4 fixes two pages of Settings. In Models, a Whisper download that stopped near its end can now be
finished, and no transcription starts on a model with files missing. In Updates, a quick click is no longer undone.

## Download

- Windows 10 and 11: `Sedjem-0.3.4-setup.exe` installs for your user, without admin rights. It isn't
  signed yet, so SmartScreen warns about an unknown publisher: choose *More info*, then *Run anyway*.
  Installing over 0.3.3 keeps your transcriptions, keys and models.
- Linux (x64): unpack `Sedjem-0.3.4-linux-x64.tar.gz` and run `Sedjem/Sedjem`.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` has the checksums of both.

0.3.3 can update itself: *Settings → Updates*, then *Update now*.

## Models

- A Whisper model in Sedjem's own folder counts as ready only when all the files of its download are there. A
  download that stopped after its largest file, `model.bin` (a cancel, an error, or the app closed), left a model
  that said *Shared copy*, as if it came from the Hugging Face cache, with no way to finish the download. It now
  says *Not downloaded* and offers the download of what is left (#111).
- An open details box no longer says that a model uses the copy in the Hugging Face cache while the model downloads
  (#109).

## Updates

- In *Settings → Updates*, a click on *Don't skip* soon after the tab opened could be undone by the tab's older
  answer, which put *Don't skip* back. The tab now asks again when its answer is older than the click (#99).
- Two quick changes in the tab now end on the last one (#101).

## Under the hood

- A job with a vocabulary hint, and some hosted jobs in a language other than English, loaded the speech engines'
  libraries into the app itself. They now load only in the separate process that runs a model on your computer (#95).
- The [privacy policy](https://github.com/MohammedEl-sayedAhmed/sedjem/blob/main/docs/privacy.md) now says that
  *Update now*, in Sedjem run from the source code, can download Python packages from PyPI (#97).

## The website and the usage counts

- The [website](https://mohammedel-sayedahmed.github.io/sedjem/) shows who runs Sedjem: installs by country and
  region, the computers, how Sedjem is used, and the website's visits by country and by day (#86). Each release is
  dated by the day it was published, and the download total no longer falls when a preview is deleted (#94). A
  release made with the Release workflow now updates the website's downloads by itself (#93).
- The usage totals of October 2026 are published (#84). The usage counts of the month so far, which the website
  shows each week, now hold headline numbers only, so that two weekly copies can't be subtracted to show one
  install's values. The
  [usage counts page](https://github.com/MohammedEl-sayedAhmed/sedjem/blob/main/docs/13-usage-counts.md) says what
  is published (#88, #91).

## Known limits

- The installer is unsigned, and macOS isn't built.
- winget doesn't have Sedjem yet; `winget install MohammedElsayedAhmed.Sedjem` will work once winget has accepted
  the package.
- Running on another computer has been tried with two copies of Sedjem on one computer, not yet between two
  computers on many networks. The first time it is turned on, Windows asks whether to let Sedjem through its
  firewall: allow it on private networks only.
- On Linux, *Update now* unpacks the new build next to the old one rather than replacing it.
- Nemotron-3-Diarization hears at most 8 speakers.

Every commit: [v0.3.3...v0.3.4](https://github.com/MohammedEl-sayedAhmed/sedjem/compare/v0.3.3...v0.3.4).
